title: Answer: unsolved de-combination, or missing physical signatures

statements.text: The view would be undercut by a sound argument that subjects cannot be aspects of other subjects or derived from them, which would leave the de-combination problem unsolved. Shani and Keppler’s version would be undercut if coherent neural states lacked the predicted photon emission, or if no mapping between qualia and phase-locked field modes could be derived.

sources.quote: how do ‘big’ subjects of experience, such as the whole universe, ground the existence of ‘little’ subjects of experience
